title: U.S. judge denies Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix bid to dismiss DRAM price-fixing lawsuit
summary: U.S. Judge Noël Wise rejected motions by Micron, Samsung and SK Hynix to dismiss a DRAM price-fixing class action \(group lawsuit\), allowing the case to proceed. The plaintiffs allege the three chipmakers coordinated to limit DRAM supply and that prices rose by as much as 500%; the ruling does not establish liability.
